title: Status Ring
summary: Display an RGB status pattern on a twelve-pixel addressable ring.

briefing.text: Display an RGB status pattern on a twelve-pixel addressable ring.
Build the circuit, write the program, then use the live objectives and hints to check each connection.

learn.title: NeoPixel
learn.body:
Display an RGB status pattern on a twelve-pixel addressable ring.

The ring needs 5 V power (VIN) and a common ground. The teaching peripheral accepts GPIO18 data; real 5 V pixels may need a data level shifter.

Set each pixel color, then call show() to transmit the buffer. Setting a color alone does not update the LEDs.

objectives.text: Power the ring from VIN/GND and connect DIN to GPIO18
